title: feat(qstartot1): among Q_star, Max(1) is not vertex3 and mixed3
science: Behind the failed iff sits an exact 1-bit characterization the note states in passing but never as a theorem: m1=12 is attained by exactly the four vertex3=1 maps, so Max(1) among Q_* IS vertex3, and since m1=12 equals the full one-site seed count those four maps fill from EVERY single site. The census (8,8,12,12,8,8,12,12) is the closed form cov1 = 8 + 4*vertex3 on Q_*, the k=1 analogue of #6582'
